capabilities: Aggregate task lines from vault notes into Today / Next 7 days / Done / Unscheduled lists
Build kanban boards from project tags and move cards between stage columns
Browse notes as a card wall grouped by folder
Capture ideas and launch them into project boards with a lifecycle
Run a pomodoro focus timer and switch theme palettes
extras: Interface is in Chinese (Chinese README included); desktop only; local-only with no network requests; not reviewed by Obsidian staff; not available in the community store — installable via BRAT or manual download.
problem: Obsidian lacks a single visual dashboard that summarizes tasks across notes, stages projects on boards, and browses notes as cards.
summary: Dashboard-style workbench that aggregates tasks, kanban boards, and note card walls from vault notes with real-time read/write.
